```{r}
# ============================================================
# Run dNdScv from pILC WES cohort MAF
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(dndscv)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# -----------------------------
# Paths
# -----------------------------

base_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common"

maf_file <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "Combined_MAF",
  "Tier_1_common_all_samples.combined.maf"
)

dndscv_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "dNdScv")
results_dir <- file.path(dndscv_dir, "results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


stopifnot(file.exists(maf_file))

message("Input MAF: ", maf_file)
message("Output directory: ", results_dir)
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Read MAF
# -----------------------------
# skip = "Hugo_Symbol" handles MAF files with comment/header lines

maf <- fread(
  maf_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  skip = "Hugo_Symbol",
  data.table = TRUE,
  showProgress = TRUE
)

message("Total MAF rows: ", nrow(maf))

# -----------------------------
# Check required columns
# -----------------------------

required_cols <- c(
  "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
  "Chromosome",
  "Start_Position",
  "Reference_Allele",
  "Tumor_Seq_Allele2",
  "Variant_Classification"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(maf))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Keep coding variants, including Silent
# -----------------------------
# Important:
# dNdScv needs synonymous/Silent mutations to estimate the background mutation rate.

coding_classes <- c(
  "Silent",
  "Missense_Mutation",
  "Nonsense_Mutation",
  "Nonstop_Mutation",
  "Splice_Site",
  "Splice_Region",
  "Translation_Start_Site",
  "Frame_Shift_Del",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins",
  "In_Frame_Del",
  "In_Frame_Ins"
)

maf_coding <- maf[Variant_Classification %in% coding_classes]

message("Rows after coding filter including Silent: ", nrow(maf_coding))
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Optional Variant_Type filter
# -----------------------------
# dNdScv is safest with SNP, INS, DEL.
# Complex multinucleotide variants are excluded and saved separately.

if ("Variant_Type" %in% colnames(maf_coding)) {
  
  maf_excluded_variant_type <- maf_coding[
    !Variant_Type %in% c("SNP", "INS", "DEL")
  ]
  
  fwrite(
    maf_excluded_variant_type,
    file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_excluded_non_SNP_INS_DEL_variants.tsv"),
    sep = "\t"
  )
  
  maf_coding <- maf_coding[Variant_Type %in% c("SNP", "INS", "DEL")]
  
  message("Rows after keeping SNP/INS/DEL: ", nrow(maf_coding))
}
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Prepare dNdScv 5-column input
# -----------------------------

dnds_input <- maf_coding[
  ,
  .(
    sampleID = Tumor_Sample_Barcode,
    chr      = Chromosome,
    pos      = Start_Position,
    ref      = Reference_Allele,
    mut      = Tumor_Seq_Allele2
  )
]

# Clean chromosome format
dnds_input[, chr := gsub("^chr", "", as.character(chr), ignore.case = TRUE)]
dnds_input[, chr := as.character(chr)]

# Keep standard chromosomes
dnds_input <- dnds_input[chr %in% c(as.character(1:22), "X", "Y")]

# Clean alleles
dnds_input[, ref := toupper(as.character(ref))]
dnds_input[, mut := toupper(as.character(mut))]

# Remove incomplete rows
dnds_input <- dnds_input[
  !is.na(sampleID) &
    !is.na(chr) &
    !is.na(pos) &
    !is.na(ref) &
    !is.na(mut) &
    sampleID != "" &
    chr != "" &
    ref != "" &
    mut != "" &
    ref != "." &
    mut != "."
]

# Remove REF == ALT
dnds_input <- dnds_input[ref != mut]

# Remove duplicate mutation records
dnds_input <- unique(dnds_input)

message("Final dNdScv input rows: ", nrow(dnds_input))
message("Number of samples: ", length(unique(dnds_input$sampleID)))

# Save dNdScv input
fwrite(
  dnds_input,
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_input_5col.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Save QC summaries
# -----------------------------

qc_variant_class <- maf_coding[
  ,
  .N,
  by = Variant_Classification
][order(-N)]

fwrite(
  qc_variant_class,
  file.path(results_dir, "QC_variant_class_counts_used_for_dNdScv.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

qc_sample_burden <- dnds_input[
  ,
  .N,
  by = sampleID
][order(-N)]

fwrite(
  qc_sample_burden,
  file.path(results_dir, "QC_mutation_count_per_sample_used_for_dNdScv.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Run dNdScv
# -----------------------------
# use refdb = "hg38"

message("Running dNdScv...")

dndsout <- dndscv(
  mutations = as.data.frame(dnds_input),
  refdb = "hg38",
  outmats = TRUE
)

message("dNdScv finished.")

# Save full R object
saveRDS(
  dndsout,
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_output_object.rds")
)

# -----------------------------
# Export main output tables
# -----------------------------

sel_cv <- as.data.table(dndsout$sel_cv)

fwrite(
  sel_cv,
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_gene_selection_results_sel_cv.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

global_dnds <- as.data.table(
  dndsout$globaldnds,
  keep.rownames = "category"
)

fwrite(
  global_dnds,
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_global_dnds.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

annotmuts <- as.data.table(dndsout$annotmuts)

fwrite(
  annotmuts,
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_annotated_mutations.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

genemuts <- as.data.table(dndsout$genemuts)

fwrite(
  genemuts,
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_gene_observed_expected_mutations.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Significant driver candidates
# -----------------------------

sig_q10 <- sel_cv[
  (!is.na(qglobal_cv) & qglobal_cv < 0.10) |
    (!is.na(qallsubs_cv) & qallsubs_cv < 0.10)
][order(qglobal_cv, qallsubs_cv)]

fwrite(
  sig_q10,
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_significant_genes_q_lt_0.10.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

sig_q05 <- sel_cv[
  (!is.na(qglobal_cv) & qglobal_cv < 0.05) |
    (!is.na(qallsubs_cv) & qallsubs_cv < 0.05)
][order(qglobal_cv, qallsubs_cv)]

fwrite(
  sig_q05,
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_significant_genes_q_lt_0.05.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Confidence intervals
# -----------------------------

message("Calculating gene-level confidence intervals...")

ci <- geneci(dndsout)

ci_dt <- as.data.table(
  ci,
  keep.rownames = "gene_name"
)

fwrite(
  ci_dt,
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_gene_dnds_confidence_intervals.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

# -----------------------------
# Simple top-gene plot
# -----------------------------

plot_dt <- copy(sel_cv)

plot_dt[
  ,
  q_for_plot := fifelse(
    !is.na(qglobal_cv),
    qglobal_cv,
    qallsubs_cv
  )
]

plot_dt <- plot_dt[
  is.finite(q_for_plot) & !is.na(q_for_plot)
][order(q_for_plot)]

plot_dt <- plot_dt[1:min(25, .N)]

plot_dt[, gene_name := factor(gene_name, levels = rev(gene_name))]
plot_dt[, neglog10q := -log10(q_for_plot)]

pdf(
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_top25_candidate_driver_genes.pdf"),
  width = 8,
  height = 7
)

ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x = gene_name, y = neglog10q)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Top candidate driver genes by dNdScv",
    x = "Gene",
    y = "-log10(q-value)"
  )

dev.off()

message("All dNdScv outputs saved to:")
message(results_dir)
```
